name: services
description: Backend microservices for authentication, resume processing, interviews, roadmaps, and billing.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n AUTH,RESUME,INTERVIEW,ROADMAP,BILLING "npm run auth" "npm run resume" "npm run interview" "npm run roadmap" "npm run billing"
scripts.start: concurrently -n AUTH,RESUME,INTERVIEW,ROADMAP,BILLING "npm run auth:start" "npm run resume:start" "npm run interview:start" "npm run roadmap:start" "npm run billing:start"

author: Chandermani
